description: Kick a roommate off your lot. Prerequisite: caller must be the current lot's owner (VMTSOLotState.OwnerID == self); target must be listed in fso_roommates for this lot. Effect: target's fso_roommates row is removed; if they are on the lot they are evicted next tick. Cost: frees a roommate slot. Refuse path: ok=false if caller is not owner or target is not currently a roommate. Wire: ChangeRoommateRequest{Type=KICK,AvatarId,LotLocation} on the city Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF evict-roommate --target_persist_id <current roommate's persist_id>            # owner-only; sends ChangeRoommateRequest KICK
common_mistakes: Evicting yourself → ok:false ('cannot evict the owner (yourself)').
target was not actually a roommate — handler warns via target_was_roommate_in_vm:false but still sends (server has authoritative view).
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (to avoid self-targeting): perception.avatar.persist_id
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id for Sims physically on the lot
Relationships for picking a roommate candidate: perception.relationships[]
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
target_persist_id is 0 or missing → returns ok:false with 'requires target_persist_id (> 0)'
target_persist_id == caller's own avatar_id → returns ok:false with 'cannot self-target' / 'cannot invite yourself'
